controlOnlyNote: Every repository below is a synthetic control-only fixture built in memory by this producer. A control that fires proves the refusal works; it is not a defect report and not evidence that the substituted form occurs in the tree.

controls.prevents: that a malformed metadata set is read as a repository whose properties were checked
controls.purpose: a metadata set missing the timestamp is not a repository

controls.prevents: that an attacker restores an old root and its old keys; a root that does not move forward is a rollback, not a rotation
controls.purpose: a root at the accepted version is a rollback, not a rotation

controls.prevents: that a party holding only the new root key replaces the root; the old root must authorise its own replacement
controls.purpose: a rotation signed by the new root alone is refused

controls.prevents: that an old targets metadata set is served as current, undoing a later delegation, revocation or file removal
controls.purpose: a targets version decrease is refused

controls.prevents: that an old snapshot is served alongside newer targets, hiding the targets version that was actually accepted
controls.purpose: a snapshot version decrease is refused

controls.prevents: that an old timestamp is replayed to make the repository look fresh at an earlier snapshot
controls.purpose: a timestamp version decrease is refused

controls.prevents: that a snapshot vouches for different targets than the ones supplied, breaking the hash chain that makes rollback detectable
controls.purpose: a snapshot that vouches for different targets is refused

controls.prevents: that a timestamp vouches for a different snapshot than the one supplied; freshness is bound to bytes, not to a role name
controls.purpose: a timestamp that vouches for a different snapshot is refused

controls.prevents: that expired metadata is read as current; expiry is what makes an old, still-correctly-signed set stop authorising anything
controls.purpose: an expired timestamp is refused even though it is version-correct

controls.prevents: that an attacker stops updating the repository and serves a valid, unexpired timestamp forever; an unrefreshed repository is a freeze
controls.purpose: an unexpired timestamp not refreshed within the interval is a freeze

controls.prevents: that a signature by a revoked key is accepted because it verifies; revocation is a decision about the key, not about the bytes
controls.purpose: a signature by a revoked key is refused although it verifies

controls.prevents: that a key past its validity window is accepted because its signature still verifies
controls.purpose: an expired key is refused although its signature verifies

controls.prevents: that a key introduced for a future rotation is used before the rotation that authorises it
controls.purpose: a key outside its validity window is refused in both directions

controls.prevents: that an invented keyid supplies a signature the root never authorised
controls.purpose: a keyid no metadata declares is refused

controls.prevents: that a timestamp key signs targets, or any key acts outside the one role the root assigned it
controls.purpose: a key the root binds to another role cannot sign targets

controls.prevents: that one key is counted twice, or a threshold is read as met by repeated signatures from the same key
controls.purpose: one distinct key cannot meet a threshold of two

controls.prevents: that an undeclared delegated role is trusted, or a declared one is silently absent
controls.purpose: targets declares a delegation that no record supplies

controls.prevents: that an expired delegated role continues to authorise targets after its delegation lapsed
controls.purpose: an expired delegation is refused although its hash binds

controls.prevents: that a delegation is replaced with different keys or different targets while keeping the name the parent approved
controls.purpose: a delegation record that disagrees with the parent's digest is refused

controls.prevents: that an old signature authorises a stale release after metadata moved on or the key was revoked
controls.purpose: a release bound to an older metadata version is refused

controls.prevents: that an old signature authorises a stale release after metadata moved on or the key was revoked
controls.purpose: a release signed by a key revoked before its recorded time is refused

controls.prevents: that a signature made over different bytes, or no signature at all, is counted toward a threshold
controls.purpose: a signature over different bytes is refused

positive.purpose: a version-incremented, threshold-signed, unexpired repository with a hash-bound delegation reaches ACCEPTED
